name: The Astronaut's Terrarium Garden
description: In the vastness of space, an astronaut tends to a magical terrarium dome containing miniature ecosystems from every planet, with floating islands, alien flowers, and crystalline trees suspended in zero gravity.
prompt: An astronaut in a sleek white spacesuit carefully tending to a large transparent terrarium dome floating in the vacuum of space, inside the dome contain miniature ecosystems from different planets - floating islands with alien flowers, crystalline trees, bioluminescent moss, and colorful atmospheric effects, distant galaxies and nebulae visible in the star-filled background, Earth visible on the horizon, highly detailed science fantasy art, cinematic lighting, sense of wonder and exploration
caption: Cultivating worlds within worlds among the stars... 🚀🌍 What universe would you nurture?
